verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe confirms a live llms.txt at developers.fellow.ai/llms.txt (HTTP 200) that describes the Fellow API docs. The developer reference is also served as per-page Markdown (.md URLs), which suits agent consumption, and the docs explicitly frame the API for LLM pipelines. Missing for 10: no machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all candidate paths returned 404), and no evidence of an llms-full.txt or a full-content agent bundle.
